main_text.p: Partic. אי מתכנפין Si congregarentur, Cantic. 8. 7. כנף Ch. Ala, ora, extremitas, fimbria. Plur. כנפין, כנפי, Syr. ܟܢܦܐ, & dicitur de qualibet re: ܟܢܦܐ Super alam templi, id est, Pinnaculū, Matt. 4.5. ܟܢܦܐ Ala, seu fimbria vesti-menti, Marc.6.v.ult. ܟܢܦܐ Extremitas maris, id est, Littus. Tremell. Sinum maris, Act.27.39.
כנר Ch. Cithara. Plur. כנרין, כנרא.

כנש Ch.& Syr. Colligere, congregare, congerere, comportare: & passivè Congregari, convenire, ut Lucæ 5.1. ܟܢܫ Qui congregaverat aquas, id est hydropicus, Lucæ 14.2. Pahel כנש Idem. Aphel אכניש Idem. Ithpah. אתכנש Congregari. Ithpehal אתכנש Idem.
ܟܢܫܐ Syr. Congregatio, populus, turba. Plural. ܟܢܫܐ:
ܟܢܫܐ Syr. Congregatio, aggregatio, 2. ad Thess. 2. 1. ad Hebr. 10. 25.

כנישתא Ch. Synagoga, coetus, congregatio: אנשי כנישתא רבתא Viri synagogæ magnæ, Cantic. 7. 2. כנישת מיא Cōgregatio aquarum, Gen. 1.10. Item Dies feriatus, Coetus ferians, Feriæ, Amos 5.21. Joel. 1.14. Plur. כנישתא, כנישׁן, Psal. 48.12.

page.notes: Many Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are set in pointed Hebrew and Syriac type; transcribed as closely as the scan allows. Some Syriac and pointed forms are only approximately legible and may differ in detail.
